Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive) for 1
Stack: 1

Thrown only; not for Grenade Launchers. Hovers over its landing square and for 15 seconds (5 Rounds) broadcasts in a 10x10m/yds (5x5 square) area around itself. Drones not under direct control that start their Turn in the area or move through it must beat DV21 Concentration (using their Combat Number) or prioritize attacking or watching the lure over targets that haven't engaged them since their last Turn. Afterward it drops, Destroyed Beyond Repair.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
